# apple_build (Data Source)

Looks up a build by its App Store Connect ID, or the latest build of an app matching `version` and `pre_release_version`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The newest build of version 1.2.0.
data "apple_build" "latest" {
  app_id              = data.apple_app.example.id
  pre_release_version = "1.2.0"
  latest              = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app, to find its latest matching build. Set this or `id`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build. Set this or `app_id`.
- `latest` (Boolean) With `app_id`: return the most recently uploaded match when several builds match. Defaults to `false`, which makes several matches an error.
- `pre_release_version` (String) With `app_id`: the version to match, e.g. `1.2.0`.
- `version` (String) With `app_id`: the build number to match.

### Read-Only

- `build_audience_type` (String) `APP_STORE_ELIGIBLE`, or `INTERNAL_ONLY` for builds uploaded as TestFlight Internal Only.
- `expiration_date` (String) When the build stops being testable, in RFC 3339 format.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether the build has expired.
- `external_build_state` (String) TestFlight state of the build for external testers, e.g. `READY_FOR_BETA_SUBMISSION`.
- `internal_build_state` (String) TestFlight state of the build for internal testers, e.g. `IN_BETA_TESTING`.
- `min_os_version` (String) Minimum OS version the build supports.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the build's version: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS` or `VISION_OS`.
- `processing_state` (String) Processing state: `PROCESSING`, `FAILED`, `INVALID` or `VALID`.
- `uploaded_date` (String) When the build was uploaded, in RFC 3339 format.
- `uses_non_exempt_encryption` (Boolean) The build's export compliance answer; null if unanswered.
